title: Pitchfork Netherite Spears
description: Have you Ever wanted a Pitchfork in Minecraft? Well today is your lucky day! This texture pack turns the Netherite Spear texture into a Pitchfork!
body:
A custom texture pack by LordLazerz that replaces the default netherite spear texture with a sleek, menacing pitchfork design. Upgrade your endgame weaponry and strike down enemies in style!

(Compatible with newer versions)
